name: Can-Am Spyder (RT, F3, RS, ST)
engine: 990 cc V-twin or 1330 cc Rotax triple, fuel injected, belt drive, two front wheels
intro: Can-Am's three-wheelers. Two wheels in front, car-like steering and lots of electronics.

L: The front end has ball joints and tie rods like a car. Check them for play and torn boots.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
